73914-the-happy-six.title: The Happy Six
73914-the-happy-six.creator: Penn Shirley
73914-the-happy-six.description: A book by Penn Shirley. 7    “Here I is, Mamma” 142    “I’ve found it!”                                  169  THE HAPPY SIX  CHAPTER I  FIVE AND ONE   “The Happy Six” grew out of “The Merry Five,” and this was the way of it:--  The Merry Five, as you may remember, were Molly, Kirke, and Weezy Rowe, and their twin neighbors, Paul and Pauline Bradstreet; and they lived in Silver Gate City, in sunny California.

arxiv-2203-15784.title: Implementation of An Automated Learning System for Non-experts
arxiv-2203-15784.creator: Phoenix X. Huang, Zhiwei Zhao, Chao Liu, Jingyi Liu, Wenze Hu, Xiaoyu Wang
arxiv-2203-15784.description: Abstract Automated machine learning systems for non-experts could be critical for industries to adopt artificial intelligence to their own applications. This paper detailed the engineering system implementation of an automated machine learning system called YMIR, which completely relies on graphical interface to interact with users.

arxiv-2206-13219.title: A Dynamical Model of the M101/NGC 5474 Encounter
arxiv-2206-13219.creator: Sean T. Linden, J. Christopher Mihos
arxiv-2206-13219.description: Abstract We present the first dynamical simulation that recreates the major properties of the archetypal nearby spiral galaxy M101. Our model describes a grazing but relatively close ( ∼ \sim 14 kpc) passage of the companion galaxy NGC 5474 through M101’s outer disk approximately 200 Myr ago.

arxiv-2301-04262.title: Rational singularities and q q -birational morphisms
arxiv-2301-04262.creator: Donghyeon Kim
arxiv-2301-04262.description: Abstract . In this paper, we generalize the notion of rational singularities for any reflexive sheaf of rank 1 1 , link our notion of rational singularities with the notion of rational singularities in [ Kov11 ] , and prove generalizations of standard facts about rational singularities.

arxiv-2303-06576.title: Implications on Cosmology from Dirac Neutrino Magnetic Moments
arxiv-2303-06576.creator: E. Grohs 1,2, A. B. Balantekin 3
arxiv-2303-06576.description: Abstract The mechanism for generating neutrino masses remains a puzzle in particle physics. If neutrino masses follow from a Dirac mass term, then neutrino states exist with opposite chirality compared to their weakly-interacting counterparts. These inactive states do not interact with their active counterparts at measurable scales in the standard model.

arxiv-2304-01848.title: Beam Alignment with an Intelligent Reflecting Surface for Integrated Sensing and Communication
arxiv-2304-01848.creator: Florian Muhr 1 , Lorenzo Zaniboni 1 , Saeid K. Dehkordi 2 , Fernando Pedraza 2 , Giuseppe Caire 2
arxiv-2304-01848.description: A 2023 arXiv research paper by Florian Muhr 1 , Lorenzo Zaniboni 1 , Saeid K. Dehkordi 2 , Fernando Pedraza 2 , Giuseppe Caire 2. In a typical communication system, in order to maintain a desired SNR ( SNR ) level, initial BA ( BA ) must be established prior to data transmission.

arxiv-2307-09722.title: Extension of Switch Point Algorithm to Boundary-Value Problems Thanks: July 1, 2023. The author gratefully acknowledges support by the National Science Foundation under grants 1819002 and 2031213, and by Office of Naval Research under grant N00014-22-1-2397.
arxiv-2307-09722.creator: William W. Hager
arxiv-2307-09722.description: Abstract In an earlier paper (https://doi.org/10.1137/21M1393315), the Switch Point Algorithm was developed for solving optimal control problems whose solutions are either singular or bang-bang or both singular and bang-bang, and which possess a finite number of jump discontinuities in an optimal control at the points in time where the solution structure changes.

arxiv-2311-12730.title: Measurement of the muon magnetic anomaly a μ a_{\mu} in the Muon g − 2 g-2 experiment at Fermilab Preprint: MUPB/Conference section:
arxiv-2311-12730.creator: Marco Incagli, Fermilab E989 Muon g-2 Collaboration
arxiv-2311-12730.description: Abstract The Fermilab Muon g-2 experiment measures the muon anomalous magnetic moment with high precision. Together with recent improvements on the theory front, the first results of the experiment confirm the long-standing discrepancy between the experimental measurements and the Standard Model predictions.

arxiv-2312-08491.title: Integrating Superregenerative Principles in a Compact, Power-Efficient NMR/NQR Spectrometer: A Novel Approach with Pulsed Excitation Journal: Nuclear Instruments and Methods in Physics Research
arxiv-2312-08491.creator: Tomas Sikorsky, Andrzej Pelczar, Stephan Schneider, Thorsten Schumm
arxiv-2312-08491.description: Abstract We present a new approach to Nuclear Quadrupole Resonance (NQR)/Nuclear Magnetic Resonance (NMR) spectroscopy, the Damp-Enhanced Superregenerative Nuclear Spin Analyser (DESSA). This system integrates Superregenerative principles with pulsed sample excitation and detection, offering significant advancements over traditional Super-Regenerative Receivers (SRRs).

arxiv-2401-01653.title: Islands and entanglement entropy in d d -dimensional curved backgrounds
arxiv-2401-01653.creator: Filip Landgren, Arvind Shekar
arxiv-2401-01653.description: Abstract A large part of the discussion on entanglement islands has explored the specific setup of 2 ​ d 2d JT gravity with a flat heatbath coupled to a 2 ​ d 2d CFT. In this paper, we consider a more general setup and treatment of islands in a d − d- dimensional AdS black hole background.

arxiv-2412-09820.title: Empowering Patients for Disease Diagnosis and Clinical Treatment: A Smart Contract-Enabled Informed Consent Strategy
arxiv-2412-09820.creator: Md Al Amin, Hemanth Tummala, Rushabh Shah, Indrajit Ray
arxiv-2412-09820.description: Abstract Digital healthcare systems have revolutionized medical services, facilitating provider collaboration, enhancing diagnosis, and optimizing and improving treatments. They deliver superior quality, faster, reliable, and cost-effective services. Researchers are addressing pressing health challenges by integrating information technology, computing resources, and digital health records.

arxiv-2508-04579.title: Derived equivalence for the simple flop of type D 4 D_{4} via tilting bundles
arxiv-2508-04579.creator: Wahei Hara
arxiv-2508-04579.description: Abstract . The aim of this article is to discuss the derived equivalence problem for a local model of the simple flop of type D 4 D_{4} , which was found by Kanemitsu [ Kan22 ] . First, tilting bundles on both sides of the flop are constructed, and then those tilting bundles are applied to prove the derived equivalence.

pmc-10540753.title: Recurrent Cystitis Associated With 2 Programmed Death 1 Inhibitors
pmc-10540753.creator: Yong Fan, Juan Zhao, Yue Mi, Zhening Zhang, Yan Geng, Liqun Zhou, Lin Shen, Zhuoli Zhang
pmc-10540753.description: Immune checkpoint inhibitors (ICIs) have revolutionized the treatment of advanced cancer, however, often with immune-related adverse events (irAEs). Adverse events involving the bladder were extremely rare with only few cases. Herein, we described a rare, recurrent cystitis associated with 2 programmed death 1 inhibitors (pembrolizumab and toripalimab) in 1 patient with advanced liver cancer.

pmc-10643968.title: Molecular markers that predict response to combined radiotherapy and immunotherapy in patients with lung adenocarcinoma: a bioinformatics analysis
pmc-10643968.creator: Lu Sun, Haiting Zhou, Cheng Wu, Yi Peng
pmc-10643968.description: BackgroundImmunotherapy has had a high success rate in treating lung adenocarcinoma (LUAD) for several decades. However, many patients do not benefit from immunotherapy alone. Recent studies revealed that a combination of immunotherapy and radiotherapy (RT) stimulates a good systemic immune response to LUAD.

pmc-10644842.title: Anticancer Drugs Compared to No Anticancer Drugs in Patients with Advanced Hepatobiliary Cancer: A Mapping Review and Evidence Gap Map
pmc-10644842.creator: Carolina Requeijo, Javier Bracchiglione, Nicolás Meza, Roberto Acosta-Dighero, Josefina Salazar, Marilina Santero, Adriana-G Meade, María Jesús Quintana, Gerardo Rodríguez-Grijalva, Anna Selva, Ivan Solà, Gerard Urrútia, Xavier Bonfill Cosp, On behalf of Appropriateness of Systemic Oncological Treat
pmc-10644842.description: IntroductionDespite being commonly recommended, the impact of anticancer drugs (ACDs) on patient-important outcomes beyond survival for advanced hepatobiliary cancers (HBCs) may not have been sufficiently assessed. We aim to identify and map the evidence regarding ACDs versus best supportive care (BSC) for advanced HBCs, considering patient-centered outcomes.

pmc-11421912.title: Obstructive Sleep Apnea and Medical Comorbidities in the Asian Population: Evidence From a Nationwide Healthcare System Data in South Korea
pmc-11421912.creator: Minbi Lee, Jihye Oh, Yoo Hyun Um, Young-Chan Kim, Tae-Won Kim, Ho Jun Seo, Jong-Hyun Jeong, Seung Chul Hong
pmc-11421912.description: ObjectiveObstructive sleep apnea (OSA) is a breathing disorder characterized by recurrent airway obstruction during sleep. Previous western studies have investigated the link between medical disorders and the pathophysiology of OSA. The prevalence and comorbidity rates of OSA; however, vary across different countries and racial groups.

pmc-11642319.title: Pseudomonas sp. G31 and Azotobacter sp. PBC2 Changed Structure of Bacterial Community and Modestly Promoted Growth of Oilseed Rape
pmc-11642319.creator: Jakub Dobrzyński, Iryna Kulkova, Zuzanna Jakubowska, Aleksandra Naziębło, Barbara Wróbel, Daniel B Raudabaugh
pmc-11642319.description: Oilseed rape is one of the most important oilseed crops, requiring high levels of nitrogen fertilization. Excessive nitrogen use, however, leads to numerous negative environmental impacts, spurring the search for sustainable, environmentally friendly alternatives to reduce reliance on mineral nitrogen fertilizers.

pmc-12429375.title: Disruption of Human Papillomavirus 16 E6/E7 Genes Using All-in-One Adenovirus Vectors Expressing Eight Double-Nicking Guide RNAs
pmc-12429375.creator: Megumi Yamaji, Tomomi Nakahara, Tomoko Nakanishi, Satomi Aoyama-Kikawa, Kiyoshi Yamaguchi, Yoichi Furukawa, Mariko Nakamura, Tadashi Okada, Hirotaka Tabata, Ryoko Fuse, Eigo Shimizu, Rika Kasajima, Seiya Imoto, Iwao Kukimoto, Izumu Saito, Tohru Kiyono
pmc-12429375.description: Human papillomavirus (HPV) is a prime target for genome-editing therapy as its E6 and E7 oncogenes are crucial for cancer development and maintenance. A key challenge in CRISPR/Cas9 therapy is the off-target effects. This study utilized a double-nicking technique to introduce DNA breaks in the E6 and E7 regions of HPV16. From 146 gRNA candidates, 16 double-nicking pairs were selected.

pmc-12580445.title: Overnight deep inspiration patterns in obstructive sleep apnea patients with and without asthma
pmc-12580445.creator: Shokoufeh Mousavi, Maryam Mohebbi, Parisa Adimi Naghan, Azadeh Yadollahi
pmc-12580445.description: A peer-reviewed research article from Europe PMC (2025). Asthma and obstructive sleep apnea (OSA) often co‐occur, exacerbating respiratory difficulties and altering airway physiology during sleep. Respiratory obstructions in OSA usually terminate with deep inspiration, and in asthma, deep inspiration may function as a bronchodilator or induce bronchoconstriction. This study investigated deep inspiration patterns using polysomnography data from 202 OSA patients (Apnea‐Hypopnea Index (AHI) > 5) in the Sleep Heart Health Study, including asthma patients and matched controls.
